gen-gf-warnes-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight keeps its lowercase compact, with short ascenders and curve tails tucked well back. Inter Tight sets a sans-serif text that reads smoothly over a long page, while Warnes stretches out above it in bold, tapered strokes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-karla: Strokes that taper out before they touch give Warnes a bold, spaced-out swagger with no thick-and-thin shifts at all. Karla sits beside it as a stocky sans with a tall middle band and a gaping c, friendly where the heading is showy.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads open and inviting, its rounded letters rising on a tall x-height. And Warnes, with its bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mixing inside a word, gives the page a loud, stretched headline voice above it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-khula: Expressive is the first word for Warnes, whose tapered ink strokes stretch out in wide, spacious tracking. Khula follows with a tall midsection and open curves, a modern sans that keeps quiet so the heading can do the talking.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-krub: Krub is a plain sans with a pronounced x-height and unfinished curves. Warnes is best at bold, spaced-out display lettering, its s having a spine as thick as its terminals, while Krub is best at carrying the running text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-kufam: Kufam draws one track width like a neon tube, with generously open curves in e and bodies that dominate each line. Warnes is the showpiece here, bold and stretched out, and Kufam is the workhorse.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-lexend: Lexend runs outsized lowercase with open jaws on every curve, approachable and plain sans in manner. And Warnes brings the pair's strongest quality: a bold, expressive heading whose tapered strokes never vary in width.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca is a plain sans with big lowercase and small capitals. Its strongest quality is how that unshaded, never-swelling line lets Warnes, bold and widely tracked, stand out as the expressive one.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-liter: Warnes arrives bold, with tapered ink strokes and wide tracking. Its job is loud display lettering, while Liter, a plain sans with tall lowercase and wide mouths on round forms, does the steady work of text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mada: Approachable describes Mada, a sans whose curves refuse to close beneath a towering midzone. And Warnes, with the same line width in curves and straights, earns its keep as a big, short, bold heading.
